Name: KGB: Episode One
Overview: Blow up machine-gun nest, Destroy an ammunition-dump, Navigate a land-mine infested maze in a burned-out forest, Rescue a helicopter pilot, Man dual M60's mounted on a helicopter, Search terrorist camp sites and burn down their operations to find the intel on their evil plans! One square mile of open sandbox! RPG's, Grenades, Heli Mounted M60's!
